meta.pageTitle: How XYZ Layout Engine Assembles a Poster

header.title: HOW XYZ LAYOUT ENGINE ASSEMBLES A POSTER
header.subtitle: Editable JSON words, transparent artwork, and a Node.js recipe become self-contained offline HTML or raster PNG.

words.caption: Edit sections.header.headline in the fixture JSON to change the poster headline words without touching layout code.

artwork.caption: Change artwork choice via hero.illustrationId ("leaf_glow") or replace the transparent leaf_glow.png illustration.

recipe.caption: Actual recipe placement: left: 262 shifts the leaf right; top: -34 pulls it upward into the header; width: 428 and height: 640 resize it.

stage.kicker: EXPLODED 3D ASSEMBLY PLANES  ·  RECOGNIZABLE PARTS OF "FUEL WELL. LIVE WELL."
stage.depthNote: Three independent layers stack in Z-depth and merge into one 1000 × 1000 scene
stage.sceneSummaryBody: buildScene(fixture) runs in Node.js at render time, combining fixture JSON text, transparent PNG cutouts, Barlow Condensed fonts, and layout style objects.

nodeStage.sub: Runs in Node.js runtime at render time
nodeStage.step1Body: source/nutrition.mjs validates fixture JSON and runs buildScene() in the Node.js runtime at render time — never in the viewer's browser.
nodeStage.step2Body: toHtml() and toDocument() in source/render.mjs serialize scene styles (position:absolute; left:262px; top:-34px) into inline CSS styling and embedded @font-face CSS in the exported HTML.

backendsStage.sub: Same styled scene · choose Satori or Playwright
backendsStage.satoriCaption: Satori lays out the scene into SVG; @resvg/resvg-js (resvg) rasterizes that SVG directly into a PNG.
backendsStage.playwrightCaption: Playwright drives headless Chromium to lay out the HTML/CSS document and capture a PNG via page.screenshot().
backendsStage.sharedHtmlBanner: EITHER BACKEND EXPORTS OFFLINE HTML — Both Satori and Playwright feed toDocument() to output self-contained offline HTML.

bullets: Selectable, searchable live text laid out with CSS styling.
Self-contained offline HTML: embedded fonts & base64 artwork, zero network calls.
Exportable from either Satori or Playwright backend.
Flattened raster pixels — fixed resolution, non-selectable text.
Produced by resvg rasterizing SVG or Chromium PNG capture.
Identical in every image viewer, slide deck, or print export.
